payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for RQE, including Logistic Regression, learning-to-rank methods, and various neural network architectures.

claims.text: The best performing system for RQE in 2017 used supervised Logistic Regression combined with unsupervised similarity measures.
A second system achieved high performance using a learning-to-rank method with Logistic Regression and features from neural networks like Bi-LSTM, GRU, and CNNs.
The paper discusses two machine learning and deep learning methods for RQE, comparing their performance on different datasets.
